name: Geometric Anisotropy Metrics (Shape Domain)
definition: A set of three barycentric coordinates (c_l, c_p, c_s) that characterize a tensor's shape within a triangular domain, representing linear, planar, and spherical certainty.
summary: Geometric Anisotropy Metrics are three scalar values derived from symmetric tensor eigenvalues to measure linear, planar, or spherical certainty, distinguishing diffusion structures independent of orientation.
